info.title: Cloudprinter.com Universal API
info.description: Quote, place, track, and cancel print orders with Cloudprinter.com, and browse products and shipping options through the Cloudprinter Core API.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

email.description: Customer email address for the order.

addresses[].type.description: Address type. Cloudprinter expects delivery for order creation.

addresses[].street1.description: Primary street line for the delivery address.

addresses[].zip.description: Postal or ZIP code for the delivery address.

addresses[].country.description: Delivery country in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

addresses[].email.description: Email for the delivery address contact.

addresses[].phone.description: Phone number for the delivery address contact. Required by the live API.

items[].reference.description: Client item reference. Must match the reference used when quoting.

items[].count.description: Number of copies to produce for this item.

items[].quote.description: Quote hash returned by Get Order Quote for this item.

items[].shippingLevel.description: Preferred shipping level when no quote hash is supplied.

items[].options[].description: Optional item options. Cloudprinter expects an array value even when empty.

items[].files[].description: Files to print for this item.

items[].files[].type.description: File type expected by the selected product.

items[].files[].url.description: HTTPS URL where Cloudprinter can download the print file.

items[].files[].md5sum.description: MD5 checksum used by Cloudprinter to validate the downloaded file.
